scenarios.name: Inspect the context menu for the Origin center point

scenario_steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the Center Point row
a context menu opens beside the point row
the menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note, Visibility and Relationships
the Center Point row is highlighted
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the Center Point row remains highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the Center Point row no longer has the filled selection highlight
the Center Point row retains a focus outline
the solid remains visible in the viewport
